headline: Kuura Strand Erupts; Last Warden Post Ruined in Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since our last edition the map has stirred anew. Kuura Strand, quiet when we last went to press, now tops the wire — fifteen engagements inside two hours, flags trading under both colors, the final entry logged as this edition closed, and a day's casualty roll there written almost wholly within those hours. The Weathered Expanse has changed shape as well: the Warden's lone post and a Colonial stronghold stand in ruin, leaving five Colonial posts against four ruin grounds, with hourly losses topping sixteen hundred and the Colonial share still climbing. The Nevish Line, silent since the prior evening, saw flags move through the afternoon without unsettling its five-to-three Warden division, though the exchange has cooled. Fisherman's Row kept up sporadic fighting into the late afternoon about Oceanwatch and Peripti Landing, while Stlican Shelf's ruined post is back in service, seven posts Colonial, two Warden. Callahan's Passage has raised no new flag since midmorning yet still exacts some nineteen thousand casualties a day, second only to the Expanse. On day five hundred twenty-nine, the thirty-four victory towns that would end the war remain unclaimed.
